name: Axe Twirling is a buff the Barbarian can cancel (#4344)
contract: Axe Twirling (800401) is a permanent self aura that widens Throw Weapon, Gutspiller and Berserker Axe at the price of 15% less damage done. Spell.dbc marks it SPELL_ATTR4_AURA_IS_BUFF and carries neither SPELL_ATTR0_NO_AURA_CANCEL nor a duration, so the only way to turn it off is cancelling the aura. The applied aura must therefore be positive (a buff, not a debuff) and CMSG_CANCEL_AURA must remove it.

steps.label: Axe Twirling is applied as a buff
Cancelling Axe Twirling turns it off
